title: Hill Stations Near Bengaluru: Weekend and Short-Trip Options
seoTitle: Hill Stations Near Bengaluru: Weekend Getaways | Kudozz Club
metaDescription: Hill stations near Bengaluru for weekends: Nandi Hills, Yelagiri, Horsley Hills, Yercaud, Sakleshpur, Chikmagalur, Coorg, BR Hills and Ooty, with distances and tips.
description: A guide to the hill stations within weekend reach of Bengaluru: Nandi Hills for a sunrise day trip, Yelagiri and Horsley Hills for a quick escape, Yercaud, Sakleshpur, Chikmagalur and Coorg for coffee country, BR Hills near Mysuru, and Ooty and Kodaikanal for a longer weekend, with approximate distances, routes, forest-road rules and seasons.
dek: Bengaluru sits within reach of the Western Ghats' coffee country and several small Eastern Ghats hill towns. Here is how to choose.
secondaryKeywords: hill stations within 300 km of Bengaluru

hero.alt: The view from Nandi Hills over the plains near Bengaluru

intro: Bengaluru's weekend hills fall into three groups: quick escapes such as Nandi Hills, Yelagiri and Horsley Hills; the coffee country of Sakleshpur, Chikmagalur and Coorg, five to six hours away; and the Nilgiris and Kodaikanal, which need a longer weekend.
Many routes pass through forests where night-time traffic is restricted, so plan to drive in daylight.
quickAnswer: The best hill stations near Bengaluru are Nandi Hills (about 60 km) for a sunrise trip; Yelagiri (about 160 km) and Horsley Hills (about 150 km) for a quick break; Sakleshpur (about 220 km), Chikmagalur (about 245 km) and Coorg (about 260 km) for coffee country; and Ooty (about 270 km) for a longer weekend. Forest roads to Ooty and Wayanad have night-time traffic restrictions.
takeaways: Nandi Hills is a sunrise day trip, about 1.5 hours away.
Coorg, Chikmagalur and Sakleshpur are the classic weekend hills, five to six hours away.
Roads through Bandipur and Mudumalai have night-time traffic restrictions; plan daylight drives.
Ooty needs an e-pass for vehicles from outside the Nilgiris district.
The monsoon makes coffee country lush but wet.

items.name: Nandi Hills, Yelagiri and Horsley Hills
body: Sunrise at Nandi Hills; a lake and short trails at Yelagiri; quiet viewpoints at Horsley Hills.

items.name: Coorg, Chikmagalur and Sakleshpur
body: Estate homestays, waterfalls and treks in the Western Ghats.

items.name: Ooty, Wayanad and Yercaud
body: The Nilgiris via Mysuru and the forests, Wayanad over the Kerala border, or Yercaud via Salem.

sections.heading: Forest roads and e-passes
list: Roads through Bandipur (to Ooty and Wayanad) and Mudumalai have night-time traffic restrictions; check current timings.
Do not stop or feed animals on forest roads.
Vehicles registered outside the Nilgiris district need a free e-pass for Ooty.
Weekend traffic leaving Bengaluru is heavy; leave before 6 am.

sections.heading: When to go
list: October to February: cool and clear; the best season.
March to May: warm in the plains, pleasant in the hills.
June to September: heavy rain in Coorg, Chikmagalur and Sakleshpur; beautiful but wet, with leeches on trails.

rows: Leave Bengaluru by 6 am for Coorg or Chikmagalur
Estate walk and a viewpoint (Raja's Seat or Mullayanagiri)
A waterfall or short trek; breakfast at the estate
Head back by 2 pm to avoid late arrival in city traffic

sections.heading: Where to stay
paras: Estate homestays are the heart of a Coorg, Chikmagalur or Sakleshpur trip, often with home-cooked meals and plantation walks. Nandi Hills has limited overnight options, so most people visit for sunrise and return. Yelagiri and Yercaud have lake-side hotels and small resorts.

sections.heading: Tips
list: For Nandi Hills sunrise, leave the city by about 4.30 to 5 am; parking fills quickly on weekends.
Carry cash for small estates and roadside stalls.
In the monsoon, check whether treks such as Mullayanagiri or Kudremukh are open.
Long weekends see heavy traffic on the Mysuru and Hassan highways.

sections.heading: Combining with other places
list: Coorg with Mysuru's palace on the way.
Chikmagalur with the Hoysala temples of Belur and Halebidu.
Ooty with Mudumalai or Bandipur for wildlife.
Yercaud with Salem, or Yelagiri with Vellore.

safety: Drive times are approximate and depend on traffic, weather and road works; weekend traffic on hill roads can double them. Avoid driving on mountain roads after dark.
Check weather and road updates before leaving, especially in the monsoon.
Book stays early for long weekends.

faqs.a: Coorg and Chikmagalur are the classic choices; Yelagiri and Sakleshpur are shorter drives.

faqs.q: Can I drive to Ooty from Bengaluru at night?
faqs.a: Roads through the Bandipur and Mudumalai forests have night-time traffic restrictions; plan to drive in daylight.

faqs.q: Coorg or Chikmagalur for a weekend?
faqs.a: Coorg has more sights and homestays; Chikmagalur has higher peaks and treks.
